armor-comment.description: Comment header in an ASCII-armored OpenPGP message.

armor-version.description: Version header in an ASCII-armored OpenPGP message.

message.description: Original ASCII-armored OpenPGP message, signed message or detached signature.

message-file.description: Original OpenPGP message or signature as an attachment, including binary packets.

message-type.description: Observed message type. This does not establish successful decryption or signature verification.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact original message bytes.

source.description: Source URL for the message artifact.

description: An OpenPGP message or signature artifact. Link a pgp-meta object containing observed recipient or issuer key IDs using extracted-from. Extracted IDs alone do not prove that a message was signed or encrypted by a particular key holder.
name: pgp-message
